method: Every entry: source/macro/use-case review plus native 48 kHz stereo default render. Host tempo runs at 120 BPM; MIDI/sidechain routed when requested. Additional render profiles are listed separately. Fingerprint correlation only flags candidates, never proves perceptual equivalence.
limitations: Offline SignalChain measurements. No claim of human audition of every preset, LUFS/true-peak compliance or DAW acceptance. Static corrective tools can correctly sound alike on a limited test signal and must be distinguished by job and stimulus response.

presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.

presets.name: Metallic Resonant Body
presets.purpose: A narrow resonant body blended under the source, followed by a short room. Tune selects the ringing frequency.
presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.

presets.name: Frequency Shift Halo
presets.purpose: Small single-sideband frequency shift mixed around the dry signal. Slow beating differs from pitch-shift doubling.
presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.

presets.name: Fold Threshold Bass
presets.purpose: Dedicated wavefolder with independent drive and fold threshold, followed by a lowpass recovery filter.
presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.

presets.name: Nonlinear Lowpass Drive
presets.purpose: Saturation before the lowpass changes the material entering the cutoff. Parallel Mix keeps the original attack.
presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.

presets.name: Tape Brake Transition
presets.purpose: One-shot slowing delay for a transition. Reload or reset the patch to restart the brake; it is not a transport stop command.
presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.

presets.name: Reverse Grain Return
presets.purpose: Filtered reverse-delay return blended with the dry input. Time sets the reverse window and Repeat controls regeneration.
presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.

presets.name: Ring Sideband Percussion
presets.purpose: Audio-rate ring modulation gives percussion inharmonic sidebands. Carrier frequency changes the metallic spacing.
presets.rationale: Adds this explicit processing/control-source use case.
